summary: Extended src/design/definition.md with a PD-03 section covering version management (Store.activate). The extension adds: (1) the full Store.activate public function signature with parameter types, return type, and all error variants; (2) the extended DefinitionError set with two new variants (AlreadyActive, NotDraft) plus their HTTP mappings; (3) a four-step SQL transaction outline with SELECT…FOR UPDATE locking on both the target row and the prior ACTIVE row, with ordering rationale for the DEPRECATED-before-ACTIVE swap; (4) an updated state transition diagram and summary table showing the DRAFT→ACTIVE side-effect of prior ACTIVE→DEPRECATED; (5) a concurrency safety analysis covering both same-id and same-name concurrent activation races; and (6) a traceability table mapping all seven PD-03 acceptance criteria to specific design elements. The existing PD-01/PD-02 content was not modified. No implementation code was written.
